title: Month 1 · the world's turn
headline: A quiet first month for the tower. The Orcs rolled a 2, so their break-the-tower clock is still at 0 of 4. The Humans rolled high and are halfway to breaking the Gnomes, and that opens a door for us.

plan: Morten delved floor 1 under C5: 275 XP under his own wards, with no realm angered.
The tower declared *ally the Humans*, the good realm next door that also borders the Orcs. A Contact or an Aid fills it; a Delve doesn't.

happened.text: *Ally the Humans* is 0 of 3. A Delve moves no clock, so no marks this month.

happened.label: bad
happened.text: The Orcs (bad: takes people for soldiers) rolled a 2 for *break the tower* and stay at 0 of 4. Their biggest threat is still four marks away.

happened.label: good
happened.text: The Humans (good: fights tyrants) rolled a 6 +1 for *break the Gnomes* and jumped to 2 of 4. They are halfway, and an Aid from us would finish it.

happened.label: good
happened.text: The Tieflings (good: fights tyrants), also out to break the Gnomes, rolled a 4 and stand at 1 of 4.

happened.label: bad
happened.text: The Elves (bad: squeezes its own people) rolled a 6 and finished *squeeze*, wringing 300 GP from their own hexes. A Contact with them is DC +4 for 3 months, and their new goal is to fortify A5, their seat (0 of 3).

happened.label: bad
happened.text: The Goblinkind (bad: takes people for soldiers) rolled a natural 1 on *press the Gnomes*, a setback, so they stay at 0 of 3.

happened.label: bad
happened.text: The Gnomes (bad: takes people for soldiers) also rolled a natural 1 on *press the Goblinkind*: 0 of 3. With three realms aiming at them, they are the map's punching bag.

tower.after: 14 GP (incense and a Potion of Healing)

threats: the Orcs' *break the tower* is 4 marks from firing. Each month a 3 or more adds one and a 6 adds two. When it fires it takes a Hold box and half the treasury (55 GP as it stands).
chances: an **Aid for the Humans in C3**, the Gnomes' seat (a Low fight: 1 Scout and 2 Guards), finishes their *break the Gnomes* (2 → 4 of 4). It also puts **+2 on our *ally the Humans*** and is worth standing +1. C3 is 2 days away through the Orcs' C4, or 3 days round through the Humans' D4 and D3.
a Contact with the Humans in D4 or D5 (1 day, DC 10) is a safer +1 on the ally clock.
the Orcs' Mine in B4, next door, holds 500 GP for a Rob (a Moderate fight: 1 Guard and 2 Toughs). It would cost standing with the Orcs, who already want the tower broken.
open: room 1.6 (2 Blink Dogs, High, 100 XP) still waits under the tower.
the purse holds 14 GP and the treasury 110 GP. Works cost 300 GP.

log: Tower: the goal is ally the Humans, a clock of 3.
Morten: Delve floor 1 under C5 (the dungeon game; no domain effect).
Order: Orcs Force 5 (d6 4) · Tieflings Force 4 (d6 6) · Elves Force 4 (d6 2) · Goblinkind Force 3 (d6 3) · Humans Force 3 (d6 1) · Gnomes Force 2 (d6 4).
The Orcs, break the tower: d6 2 = 2 → nothing: 0 of 4.
The Tieflings, break the Gnomes: d6 3 +1 (Force 4 over 2) = 4 → one mark: 1 of 4.
The Elves, squeeze: d6 6 = 6 → two marks: 2 of 2.
The Elves (bad: squeezes its own people) did squeeze: 300 GP squeezed out, Contact there is DC +4 for 3 months.
The Elves (bad: squeezes its own people): new goal, fortify A5 (clock 3).
The Goblinkind, press the Gnomes: d6 1 +1 (Force 3 over 2) = 2 → setback: 0 of 3.
The Humans, break the Gnomes: d6 6 +1 (Force 3 over 2) = 7 → two marks: 2 of 4.
The Gnomes, press the Goblinkind: d6 1 −1 (Force 2 under 3) = 0 → setback: 0 of 3.
